traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: The Flatwoods Monster has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.text:
The Flatwoods Monster's thoughts are unreadable, and any creature attempting to mentally interact
with it must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Flatwoods Monster makes two claw and one eye ray attack, or two eye ray attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Eye Ray
actions.text: Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) radiant damage.

actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text:
All other creatures within 30 feet of the Flatwoods Monster that can hear it must
make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, becoming frightened on a failure.  At the end of each of its turns, a creature
frightened in this way can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
